maddeler.e:
أنفرط (form VII)
# أَنْفَرِطُ (ʔanfariṭu) /ʔan.fa.ri.tˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَرَطَ (infaraṭa)
# أَنْفَرِطَ (ʔanfariṭa) /ʔan.fa.ri.tˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَرَطَ (infaraṭa)
# أَنْفَرِطْ (ʔanfariṭ) /ʔan.fa.ritˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَرَطَ (infaraṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
